FULL TEXT:
University of Kashmir
NAAC Accredited Grade A++
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar 190006, Kashmir.
P a g e | 0
Brief Advertisement Notice No. 18 of 2026,
Dated: 10.11.2026
Online applications are invited from the domiciles of UT of Jammu & Kashmir for the post of Calligraphist in the Pay Range of
25500–81100/Level 4, available in the University of Kashmir as detailed below:
S. No. Department/Section/Unit/Campus No. of posts/ reservation
01 Persian UR: 01
Age:
The age of candidates as on 01.01.2026 should be:
a) Not below 18 years; and
b) Not above
1. 40 years in case of Open merit;
2. 42 years in case of Physically Challenged candidates;
3. 43 years in case of SC/ST-1/ST-2/BA/OBC/EWS/LAC/IB;
4. 50 years in case of substantive in-service employees of the University.
Important Dates:
01 Submission of Online application forms w.e.f. 12.11.2026
02 Last date for submission of Online Application Forms 30.11.2026
(upto 4.00 p.m.)
03 For in-service candidates applying through proper channel (if applicable)
Last date for submission of Hard copies 04.12.2026
The detailed Advertisement Notice containing essential qualifications and other terms & conditions will be available on the
University website www.kashmiruniversity.net under Jobs/Recruitment link from 12th of November, 2026.
Sd/-
Mushtaq Ahmad Mir
Deputy Registrar
(Recruitment)
No.: KU/Rect/Calligraphist/Re-Advt-II/26
Date: 10th of November, 2026
Copy to:
- Media Advisor, UoK for wide publicity and publication in local newspaper/s;
- In-charge Director, IT&SS with the request to direct the concerned to upload the notice on the University
Website;
- File.
